name: Bug Tracker
description: A local-first bug tracking application for development teams. Track software bugs with status workflows (open, in-progress, resolved, closed), priority levels (critical, high, medium, low), and team member assignment. Includes a dashboard with live summary data and filtering capabilities.

requirements.title: Bug CRUD
requirements.description: Users can create, view, edit, and delete bug reports. Each bug has a title, description, status, priority, assignee, and creation date.

stories.title: Manage bugs
stories.iWant: to create, view, edit, and delete bug reports
stories.soThat: I can track issues in the codebase

acceptanceCriteria.given: I am on the bugs list page
acceptanceCriteria.then: a form appears where I can enter title, description, priority, and assignee, and submitting creates the bug

acceptanceCriteria.when: I visit the bugs list page
acceptanceCriteria.then: I see all bugs displayed as clickable cards showing title, status badge, and priority badge

acceptanceCriteria.given: I am viewing a bug detail page
acceptanceCriteria.then: a pre-populated form lets me update any field and save changes

acceptanceCriteria.given: I am viewing a bug detail page
acceptanceCriteria.then: the bug is removed and I am returned to the bugs list

requirements.title: Status workflow
requirements.description: Bugs follow a defined status workflow: open -> in-progress -> resolved -> closed. Status transitions are available on the bug detail page.

stories.title: Transition bug status
stories.iWant: to move bugs through status stages
stories.soThat: the team can see the current state of each issue

acceptanceCriteria.given: I am viewing a bug with status 'open'
acceptanceCriteria.then: the status changes to 'in-progress' and the UI updates immediately

acceptanceCriteria.given: I am viewing a bug with status 'in-progress'
acceptanceCriteria.then: the status changes to 'resolved' and the UI updates immediately

acceptanceCriteria.given: I am viewing a bug with status 'resolved'
acceptanceCriteria.then: the status changes to 'closed' and the UI updates immediately

requirements.title: Dashboard overview
requirements.description: A dashboard landing page showing summary statistics (total bugs, bugs by status, bugs by priority) and quick navigation to the bugs list.

stories.title: View dashboard summary
stories.iWant: to see an overview of all bugs at a glance
stories.soThat: I can quickly assess the state of the project

acceptanceCriteria.then: I see total bug count and a breakdown by status (open, in-progress, resolved, closed)
I see a breakdown by priority (critical, high, medium, low)

acceptanceCriteria.when: I look at the recent bugs section
acceptanceCriteria.then: I see the 5 most recently created bugs with clickable links to their detail pages

requirements.title: Filtering and search
requirements.description: Users can filter the bugs list by status, priority, and assignee to quickly find relevant issues.

stories.title: Filter bugs list
stories.iWant: to filter bugs by status, priority, and assignee
stories.soThat: I can focus on the issues that matter to me

acceptanceCriteria.given: I am on the bugs list page
acceptanceCriteria.when: I select a status from the status filter dropdown
acceptanceCriteria.then: only bugs matching that status are shown

acceptanceCriteria.given: I am on the bugs list page
acceptanceCriteria.when: I select a priority from the priority filter dropdown
acceptanceCriteria.then: only bugs matching that priority are shown

acceptanceCriteria.given: I have applied one or more filters
acceptanceCriteria.then: all filters are reset and the full bug list is shown
